meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在你指定的 NanoClaw 群里搭建持久 wiki 知识库:创建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录、初始 index.md/log.md、配套容器技能,并在群 CLAUDE.md 里加入 wiki 维护说明。
howto.when: 当你说“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等触发词,或要求给群添加知识库时触发。

say.note: 开始搭建持久 wiki 知识库。

say.text: 用 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式建知识库
say.note: 会先读模式文档,再和你讨论设计。

say.text: 在新的群帮我建一个 wiki
say.note: 会询问选哪个群并搭建目录结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group: it creates wiki/ and sources/ directories, initial index.md and log.md, a container skill, and a wiki maintenance section in the group's CLAUDE.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", or "karpathy wiki"; also when you ask to add a knowledge base to a group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki to this group.
say_en.note: Starts setting up the persistent wiki.

say_en.text: Set up a knowledge base using Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
say_en.note: It reads the pattern doc first, then discusses design with you.

say_en.text: Create a wiki in a new group for me.
say_en.note: It asks which group to use and creates the structure.
